'''Annihilator 6K-A2''' was the designation of a [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoid]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that organized war games on the behalf of the [[Colicoid Creation Nest/Legends|Colicoid Creation Nest]]. It was destroyed around [[3642 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Annihilator 6K-A2 appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a final boss in the "Colicoid War Games" flashpoint. He is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]]. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means it was destroyed.
